topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Oh, I can't believe I figured this out! So I got this package today, and at first, I was like, "What the heck is this?" The address was right, but the name? Not mine, not by a long shot. Turns out, it’s for the guy who lived here before me. So, I did a little digging, asked around, found out where he moved to. Got him on the phone, and guess what? He couldn’t believe someone had actually tracked him down over a misplaced package. We had a good laugh, and he said he’s been waiting for this thing for ages. I even offered to mail it to him. It’s not every day you get to make someone’s day like that, you know?
